entities.text: Numan Sk. & Ors. Vs. The State of Jharkhand & Ors.)
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: A counter affidavit has been filed on behalf of the respondent nos.3 to 6 stating inter alia that maximum raiyats (about 80%) of the concerned mouza have already received compensation in lieu of acquisition of their land.
It has also been stated that the impugned order dated 15.12.2020 passed by the respondent no.3 is justified in accordance with law.
Be that as it may.

Since the petitioners do not appear to be satisfied with the quantum of compensation fixed in lieu of acquisition of their land and vide impugned order dated 15.12.2020, the respondent no. 3 has already rejected their application(s), this Court is not inclined to entertain the present writ petition on merit.
The petitioners are, however, at liberty to prefer application(s) before the respondent no.3 under Section 18 of the Land Acquisition Act 1894.

On receipt of the said application(s), the respondent no.3, after providing opportunity of hearing to the petitioners/their representatives, shall pass an appropriate order with respect to referring the matter to the concerned court within eight weeks from the date of filing of the said application(s).
The writ petition is disposed of with aforesaid liberty and direction.

(Rajesh Shankar, J.) Sanjay/
